svg.title: TEGE UX stencil
svg.desc: Copy a part from here, paste into TEMPLATE-screen.svg, edit the text. House style: 3px ink borders, hard 6px offset shadows drawn as real rectangles (no filters, so Inkscape stays fast and the SVG stays editable).

g.inkscape:label: 00 Paper
g.text: Copy a part. Paste into TEMPLATE-screen.svg. Edit the text. Never redraw from scratch.

g.inkscape:label: Empty state
g.text: An empty list must SAY it is empty.
A blank panel reads as broken.
